written_before: any development, synthetic-development or protected score of any arm
calibration_rule:
training-side lines only (no dev_sample, test or CLANNAD VN): teacher_train's crops with
              MeikiOCR's character boxes (VOCR5-S/N/L), and vertical training columns read by MeikiOCR's
              vertical recognizer (VOCR5-V). For each model: shift = the median, over the characters of
              group 0, of MeikiOCR's box centre minus the frame centre (resized px), and per group the median
              of the same difference minus the shift (groups with fewer than CAL_MIN characters: 0), on lines
              the model reads exactly as MeikiOCR does (VOCR5-V: the equal characters of an alignment, on
              columns MeikiOCR reads within charbox_sets.MAX_GT_CER_V of VOCR5-V; its vertical recognizer
              rarely reads a whole column exactly). Writes eval/charboxes_cal.json.

method_of_record.chosen_on: training-side lines only (eval/charbox_eval.py train-check, the lines after the calibration's in its seeded order); exploration before it on other training-side lines (issue #114)

units.rule: eval/charbox_sets.py units: textspot-dev references (dev_sample VNs), devnative's dev_sample lines (+ every PSP line on its frame at 2x, cv2.INTER_LINEAR: adrenaline), the vertical study's development columns; no test VN

meiki.rule: MeikiOCR (teacher/engines.Meiki, pinned files) on each unit's view; reference box = the aligned equal MeikiOCR character, lines within MAX_GT_CER (0.2; columns 0.6)

hand.rule: eval/charbox_hand.py sheets (seed 20261023, 48 Vita + 48 PSP native dialogue lines), every MeikiOCR box checked by eye before any score (reviewer_kind assistant); the hand-checked subset scores only the accepted boxes

sets.synthetic: report only: the synth4 renderer's development split with exact glyph boxes (helper overlay-boxes-synth), when it is ready; never a gate

line_sources.fixed: the unit's ink box plus the console pad (4 px; PSP 2), dark text with VOCR_INVERT
line_sources.finder: GRAD + refine (DEFAULT) on the unit's region; columns: vertical_twin.find_columns variant 1; one-to-one matching (eval's rule)
line_sources.ts1: textspot v0.3.3 det+refine on the whole textspot-dev frame
line_sources.ts3: textspot3 v0.3.4 det+refine on the whole textspot-dev frame

metrics.cursor_hit: estimated centre inside the reference box along the reading direction and, across it, inside the reference line's ink box plus the pad; over aligned pairs (hit_all: every reference character with a box, missing reads as misses)
metrics.iou: 1-D along the reading direction, the cell and the ink box against the reference box
metrics.ci: VN-cluster bootstrap of the hit ratio, 10,000 resamples, numpy seed 0

bar.rule: cursor-hit >= 0.970 in every one of the six (part, line source) cells
bar.pass: the C module runtime/vocr_charbox.c with twin parity, then Rubi's overlay mode
bar.fail: the other arms, then a report of the model change needed; no runtime change

protected: vita-test and psp-test, fixed and finder lines, VOCR5-N, cal+ink, reference boxes made the same way; read once at the end as a check, after the development results are committed; never used to choose anything

amendments.what: eval/charbox.py: positions() takes a cap (default 256, as before), resized_width() and align_map() added (the C module's twin); eval/charbox_eval.py: report --units adds the record arm's table by group; runtime/vocr_charbox.c/.h added and pinned
amendments.why: the C runtime after the bar was met, and the misses-by-group table; no scored number changes: a re-score of 300 units' fixed lines (3,450 records, every model and arm) is identical to the stored scores

amendments.what: eval/charbox_eval.py gains the report-only 'synth' subcommand (the method against eval/charbox_synth.py's exact glyph boxes); eval/charbox_synth.py (the helper's renderer wrapper) is pinned from now on
amendments.why: the protocol's report-only synthetic set (docs/char-boxes.md, Development sets): its scorer was not in the protocol commit; no development or protected score, arm, calibration or threshold changes
